context: Use the existing EmptyState component. Name the facets currently narrowing the result set and offer a one-click widen. Distinguish empty-by-filter from a load failure, which already has ErrorMessage handling.
description: Query.tsx imports no EmptyState. When facet selection narrows to zero results the page renders the table shell with a zero count and no guidance (Query.tsx:725-846), so the reader cannot tell whether the query is loading, broken, or genuinely empty.

anti_patterns.instead: make worktree-create BRANCH=... WORKTREE_PATH=... then make agent-write-preflight
anti_patterns.why: AGENTS.md makes the primary clone read-only for agents
it already carries the role=status semantics

anti_patterns.dont: show the empty state while the cold-snapshot retry window is still open
anti_patterns.instead: branch only once loading has settled
anti_patterns.why: db.ts retries empty reads during a cold window; a premature empty state would be wrong

preserves.behavior: Existing loading skeleton and error paths in Query; the empty state is a third branch, not a replacement
The cold-read retry window in db.ts, which can legitimately return zero rows briefly
